proposal.hypothesis: A factor-three target tile with 128 threads (384 outputs per block) tests an intermediate register/reuse tradeoff between the valid factor-two and factor-four candidates. Earlier factor-two candidates were faster than factor four but slower than baseline; whether factor three improves that balance must be established by the controller's full correctness checks and official timing.

retained: Map three target particles per thread, with their indices separated by blockDim.x, and accumulate three independent force vectors.
Load each source particle's position and mass once per source-loop iteration and reuse them across valid target accumulators.
Set the launch to 128 threads and 384 logical outputs per block; retain zero shared-memory allocation.
Keep independent validity and self-interaction checks and store each valid target once, covering arbitrary N and partial final tiles.
